ScheduleBlock.title: ScheduleBlock
ScheduleBlock.description: A visual time-blocked routine or event shown on the KlydoDay clock dial and daily timeline.

title.description: Short display title for the scheduled block.

startMinutes.description: Start time in minutes from midnight (0-1439).

colorHex.description: Hex color string (#RRGGBB) used for the clock wedge and timeline card.

daysOfWeek.description: Active weekday codes (MON..SUN); empty array means every day.

chimeEnabled.description: Whether to play a chime when this schedule block begins.

completedDateKey.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) if marked complete for that day, or empty string.

DisplaySettings.title: DisplaySettings
DisplaySettings.description: Permanent home display preferences including active Klydo artwork, pendulum finish, chime toggles, and night mode.

activeKlydoId.description: Identifier of the active Klydo animated art face.

autoCycleArt.description: Whether Klydo art faces rotate automatically.

cycleIntervalMinutes.description: Minutes between automatic Klydo art rotations (15-1440).

pendulumStyle.description: Visual finish of the digital pendulum.

pendulumEnabled.description: Whether the animated pendulum pane is active.

hourlyChimeEnabled.description: Whether to sound a subtle harmonic chime on the hour.

blockChimeEnabled.description: Whether to sound a chime when a scheduled block starts.

keepScreenOn.description: Keeps the tablet screen awake for permanent home display use.

nightModeEnabled.description: Automatically dims display and mutes chimes during sleep hours.

nightStartMinutes.description: Night mode start time in minutes from midnight (0-1439).

nightEndMinutes.description: Night mode end time in minutes from midnight (0-1439).

clockFormat24h.description: Use 24-hour digital time format in the scheduler readout.

showFrame.description: Whether the Baltic-birch plywood and charcoal clock cabinet frame is rendered around the dial.

favoriteKlydoIds.description: Bounded list of up to 20 favorited Klydo artwork IDs.

/users/{userId}/schedule_blocks/{blockId.description: User-owned visual schedule blocks rendered around the clock dial and in the daily routine timeline.

/users/{userId}/display_settings/{settin.description: User-owned home display configuration and Klydo artwork preferences.
